items.difficulty_reason: Description lemma (statement 413-426, proof 428-445): computes the pushforward and pullback of the topos morphism f_Zar componentwise - the pushforward is immediate, the pullback via the cofinality of the indexing categories and the fact that sheafification and the coverings of Y_Zar are componentwise; no verification is omitted. H2: componentwise bookkeeping over the topos morphism.
